units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 91:5">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCI</cite>; <cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 35:8">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXV</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 120:5">Yalk. Gen. 120</cite> <he>כאדם שהוא נותן ס׳ לכיפה</he> as one inserts a key-stone in an arch.

<cite ref="Berakhot 47b:15">Ber. 47ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. VI, 11ᵇ top <he>עושין אותו ס׳ לעשרה</he> we wedge him in among the ten, i.e. we count him in so as to make up the requisite number; a. fr.—Pl. <he>סְנִיפִים</he>, <he>סְנִיפִין</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 7:9">Tosef. Snh. VII, 9</cite> <he>בבית … עושין אותן ס׳</he> at a wedding feast we place them among (the adults); <cite ref="Horayot 13b:8">Hor. 13ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Taanit 25a:8">Taan. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>ס׳ עשאום</he> they made them (the beams) in links, i.e. joined mortised pieces to them.

<cite ref="Tosefta Menahot 11:6">Tosef. Men. XI, 6</cite> <he>ארבע ס׳ … היו וכ׳</he> four golden attachments were there (to the table) shaped like forks; <cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 11:6">Men. XI, 6</cite>.
<cite ref="Menachot 94b:6">Ib. 94ᵇ</cite> <he>והס׳ מעמידין וכ׳</he> and these attachments supported the loaves; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:14">Num. R. s. 4</cite>; a. fr.—
Kel. XXI, 3 ס׳ the side-pieces of a saw which hold the blade, and the wedge with which the cord is twisted
